blocks.text: South Korean actor Ko Kyung-pyo is under police investigation for drunk driving after crashing his car into a street-cleaning truck in Seoul early Saturday, Nov. 14. The collision occurred at around 3:30 a.m. in Donggyo-dong, Mapo-gu, while Ko was driving his car, news reports said. Police officers dispatched to the scene administered a breathalyzer test, which showed that Ko’s blood alcohol concentration exceeded the legal threshold for license revocation. Under South Korean law, drivers with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.08 percent or higher face license revocation. Ko’s exact blood alcohol level has not been disclosed.
